reply_text:
*I’d hold the merge—two validation gaps.*

1. *High: validation accepts a valid substring, not the whole slug* — `src/validate.js:1–4`  
   `/[a-z0-9-]+/` accepts any string containing at least one allowed character. Confirmed that `Hello`, `hello/world`, `../admin`, `hello world`, and `"hello\n"` all pass and produce page paths. URL encoding doesn’t enforce the documented slug rules.  
   *Fix:* enforce whole-string validation, including rejection of trailing line terminators. Add negative tests for uppercase, slashes, dots, whitespace, punctuation, and mixed valid/invalid input.

2. *High: reserved slugs aren’t enforced on the page path* — `src/route.js:4–5`  
   `isReserved()` is never called by the validator or route. All four reserved names—`new`, `edit`, `admin`, `api`—pass validation and generate `/p/<reserved>`, contrary to the documented protection for app routes. The reserved-word test only tests the helper, not enforcement.  
   *Fix:* reject reserved names at the page-path boundary and test all four through `pagePath()`.

Reviewed `main` (`9ba0eca`) → `slug-validation` (`e8612a7`). All 4 existing tests pass, but they miss both gaps; I reproduced both directly. No code changed.
